text:
Situation: Indigotindisulfonate sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-08-23 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 50 months. Corvale East holds 31 units with 7.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 64 units with 14.8 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 10 units with 8.5 days on hand. The product used carries NDC 81284031505 labeled by Provepharm Inc. with manufacturing plant CENEXI (FEI 3007250542) in France.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1245208 at CENEXI ended 2022-10-26 and was classified VAI, 64 days after the shortage was first posted. Earlier inspections at the same plant include an OAI classification in 2015 and VAI classifications in 2012, 2016, and 2018.

Our position: Supply is critically low at Corvale East. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a limited transfer without jeopardizing its own supply. Corvale Lakeside inventory is not targeted for transfer at this time.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 units of 8 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — product is not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No other transfers or purchases at this time.
